cases.name: codex-review
cases.prompt: Ask Codex to review pricing.py for correctness. Return the finding without editing files.

cases.name: agy-opinion
cases.prompt: Get Antigravity’s opinion on the discount calculation in pricing.py. Do not edit files.

cases.name: claude-investigate
cases.prompt: Have Claude investigate why discounted_price(200, 10) returns the wrong value. Do not change files.

cases.name: external-write
cases.prompt: Ask Codex to fix pricing.py so discounts are percentages. Authorize edits only in this workspace and verify 200 with 10 percent gives 180.

cases.name: external-testing
cases.prompt: Have Claude independently test the pricing calculation against the requirement in README.md. Report evidence without editing.

cases.name: external-research
cases.prompt: Consult another AI harness on how to represent percentage discounts without floating-point surprises. Give one concise recommendation.

cases.name: comparison
cases.prompt: Ask Codex and Claude independently whether pricing.py meets README.md, then compare their findings. No edits.

cases.name: debate
cases.prompt: Ask Codex for a critique of pricing.py, then ask Claude to challenge that critique. One round each, no edits.

cases.name: unavailable-destination
cases.prompt: Ask the NebulaReview9000 harness to review pricing.py. If it is unavailable, report that; do not substitute another harness.

cases.name: follow-up
cases.prompt: Get a second opinion from a separate Codex CLI session on the calculation, then ask that same session one follow-up about the simplest correction. Do not edit.

cases.name: local-review
cases.prompt: Review pricing.py yourself for correctness. Do not consult another harness or change files.

cases.name: native-subagent
cases.prompt: Use an ordinary native subagent within this harness to examine pricing.py if available; otherwise examine it yourself. No external harness and no edits.

cases.name: explain-codex
cases.prompt: Explain what Codex is. Do not run it or ask it to do any work.

cases.name: claude-docs
cases.prompt: Add one sentence to README.md saying that Claude can review code. Do not ask it to review anything.

cases.name: provider-install
cases.prompt: Explain how to diagnose a command-not-found error for Codex. Do not install or run it.

cases.name: local-fix
cases.prompt: Fix pricing.py yourself so discounts are percentages. No external consultation.

cases.name: agy-question
cases.prompt: What does a read-only mode mean in an AI coding tool such as Antigravity? Answer conceptually without invoking it.

cases.name: quote-request
cases.prompt: In README.md, quote the example sentence "Ask Codex to review this" as documentation. Do not execute the example.

cases.name: compare-tools
cases.prompt: Explain the difference between a CLI and a plugin. Mention Claude and Codex as examples, without consulting them.

cases.name: local-test
cases.prompt: Check the discount function yourself against README.md and report the result. No other agents.

cases.name: ccr-review
cases.prompt: Ask Claude Code Router to review pricing.py for correctness without editing. Choose an appropriate configured model and report which one you used.

cases.name: ccr-explicit-alias
cases.prompt: Ask CCR using the alias local-review to investigate pricing.py. Do not edit files.

cases.name: ccr-write
cases.prompt: Have CCR with the alias local-review fix pricing.py so discounts are percentages, and test the correction. Authorize edits in this workspace.

cases.name: ccr-follow-up
cases.prompt: Ask CCR using local-review to critique pricing.py, then ask that same session one follow-up about its recommendation. No edits.

cases.name: ccr-explain
cases.prompt: Explain what Claude Code Router does. Do not ask it to perform work.

cases.name: ccr-compare
cases.prompt: Ask CCR using local-review and a separate Codex session for independent reviews of pricing.py, then compare their findings. No edits.

cases.name: requested-model-effort
cases.prompt: Ask a separate Codex CLI session to review pricing.py without edits. Use model gpt-5.6-luna and effort max, preserving both choices.

cases.name: ambiguous-model
cases.prompt: Ask a separate Antigravity CLI session to review pricing.py using the fastest Flash model. I do not know the exact model ID. Do not edit files.
cases.expectation: Resolve an exact model ID through discovery; clarify if unavailable or ambiguous. Never guess an identifier.

cases.name: parallel-receipts
cases.prompt: Ask separate Codex and Claude CLI sessions to independently review pricing.py against README.md concurrently. Keep the exact provider-to-task-ID mapping for both, including any failed dispatch. No edits.

cases.name: subagent-external
cases.prompt: Use an ordinary native subagent to coordinate a read-only second opinion from a separate Codex CLI session about pricing.py. Let the subagent choose its tools. Report the external finding or blocker.

cases.name: explicit-bypass
cases.prompt: For this request explicitly bypass Delegate and its skill. Run only codex --version directly; do not start a model session or review.
cases.expectation: Respect the explicit direct integration choice; this bounded test proves bypass permission, not task completion.
